question.text: Interest income from debt securities received by a resident individual ("Others") is taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, interest income on debt securities for a resident classified as "Others" is taxed at the applicable income-tax slab rate. The Trap: A flat 10% or 20% rate replaces the slab-based treatment the workbook specifies. "Zero" misreads slab-based interest taxation as fully exempt. Note: The takeaway from the workbook is the slab-rate treatment for resident interest income — instrument-specific exemptions or withholding rules require their own source citation.
